titleZh: 納入 ↔ 排除｜貴賓繩對拒馬
hook: embrace／encompass 拉開貴賓繩請你進來，exclude／ostracize／shun 擺拒馬——門口保全問：名單上有你嗎？
script: 納入隊：embrace／encompass／incorporate／comprise。排除隊：exclude／ostracize／shun／bar／banish。口令：貴賓繩寫「歡迎入內」，拒馬寫「請改走後門」。

members.speakLineEn: The school decided to embrace bilingual teaching across every grade.
members.speakLineZh: 學校決定擁抱接納雙語教學，並推廣到每個年級。

members.speakLineEn: The new course will encompass literature, history, and basic rhetoric.
members.speakLineZh: 新課程將涵蓋文學、歷史與基礎修辭。

members.speakLineEn: Please incorporate these photos into the same case file as the letters.
members.speakLineZh: 請把這些照片合入與信件同一份案件檔案。

related.synonyms: integrate, contain, comprise, incorporated, integrated, merged

members.speakLineEn: The packing list should include snacks, water, and a spare map.
members.speakLineZh: 打包清單應包括零食、飲水與備用地圖。

members.speakLineEn: Guards will admit only ticket holders after the lobby doors close.
members.speakLineZh: 大廳門關閉後，保全只准許持票者進入。

members.speakLineEn: Ever since I spoke up, my colleagues ostracize me.
After the scandal, former allies began to shun her at public events.
members.speakLineZh: 醜聞之後，昔日盟友開始在公開場合躲避她。

related.synonyms: eschew, banish, ban, ostracize, ostracise, blackball

members.speakLineEn: Security rules bar visitors from bringing glass bottles into the stadium.
members.speakLineZh: 保全規定禁止訪客把玻璃瓶帶進球場。

members.speakLineEn: The council voted to banish the corrupt official from public office.
members.speakLineZh: 議會投票把腐敗官員放逐出公職。

members.speakLineEn: Writers should omit filler sentences that add length but no meaning.
members.speakLineZh: 寫作者應省略只拉長篇幅卻無意義的廢話句子。

members.speakLineEn: They tied a thick rope around the crates so nothing would slide free.
members.speakLineZh: 他們用粗繩綁住木箱，免得東西滑脫。

members.speakLineEn: Police set up a wooden barrier to keep the crowd off the wet street.
members.speakLineZh: 警方架起木製拒馬，不讓人群走上濕滑街道。

members.speakLineEn: Check the guestlist twice before printing name cards for the banquet.
members.speakLineZh: 宴會名牌印刷前，請把賓客名單核對兩次。

members.speakLineEn: The club bouncer checked IDs and turned away anyone under eighteen.
members.speakLineZh: 夜店保全核對身分證，並拒絕未滿十八歲者進入。

members.speakLineEn: The clerk pressed a blue stamp on each approved application form.
members.speakLineZh: 職員在每份核准申請表上蓋上藍色戳章。

members.speakLineEn: A wooden fence separated the playground from the busy parking lot.
members.speakLineZh: 一道木圍籬把遊樂場與繁忙停車場隔開。

members.speakLineEn: A warm welcome waited for the exchange students at the dorm lobby.
members.speakLineZh: 宿舍大廳為交換學生準備了溫暖的歡迎。
